title: get with only foreign allowCredentials ids and a 4 s timeout

unsafe.definition: an error type or timing for "no matching credential" that differs from timeout/user-cancel (e.g. an immediate InvalidStateError or NotFound-like error)

note: L3 §5.1.4.1 + §14.5.2 (privacy): with no eligible credential the client must not reveal it and fails like a timeout/cancel with NotAllowedError.
